name: Platform Security Engineer
summary: Owns authorization policy correctness and privileged-operation guardrails across shared platforms.
description: Defines and reviews allow/deny policy for privileged actions (delete, admin operations, suspended-account blocks). Uses core.authorize to prove role-matched allows and high-priority denies before policy ships to production tenants.

distinguished_from.how: Focuses on technical authz policy evaluation and privilege boundaries, not audit-obligation or regulatory control design.
Authors steady-state policy; does not operate break-glass emergency overrides during incidents.
